RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: unknown; a defensible 0–100 estimate isn’t possible from these facts

An all-women panel does not itself indicate sex bias. Neither does another woman’s appointment, although that does not rule bias out.

Your longer experience and qualifications justify asking for substantive feedback, but do not automatically establish that you were the strongest candidate for a leadership role. Client relationships, staff management and business development may legitimately matter.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting and how your application was assessed. Two weeks’ silence alone is not evidence of discrimination. Raise sex bias if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-related remarks or inconsistent treatment—not simply because of the panel’s composition.
